app_identity.title: Winnie Hou — Business English Mastery LMS
app_identity.positioning: A elite LMS and executive coaching platform for global working professionals to master C-suite Business English, executive presence, and high-stakes negotiation.
app_identity.visual_direction: Velvet Rope Membership & Editorial Elite. Modeled after candaceowens.com layout (horizontal scroll rows, explore-all links, bold editorial hero, membership CTA band, dark luxury surface) re-colored to Navy, Gold, and Ivory.

pricing_funnel_rule.rule_details: DO NOT surface dollar prices or instant purchase buy-now buttons on public pages (Home, Catalog, Course Detail, Shop, Coaching). All public cards show 'Enquire' or 'Explore Course'. Real pricing and instant Stripe deposit/checkout are strictly reserved for the personalized /start prospect landing page.

data_testid_requirement.pattern: kebab-case data-testid on every button, link, search input, filter chip, card, modal, enquiry form, and navigation item (e.g., data-testid='nav-courses-link', data-testid='course-card-enquire-btn', data-testid='start-checkout-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure Playfair Display font is loaded in index.html for all headings, and Manrope is set as font-sans.
2. Ensure all dark backgrounds use Navy #0A192F as primary, Midnight #050E1E for secondary depth, and Gold #D4AF37 for accents and borders.
3. Apply horizontal scroll carousels for course, shop, and blog rows on the Home page and Catalog, adhering to the Candace Owens UI model with 'Explore All →' links.
4. Maintain hidden pricing on public pages (show 'Enquire' / 'POA'). Unlock pricing and direct Stripe checkout ONLY on /start.
5. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: No generic centered cards with standard grey backgrounds. Use rich navy layers, gold ambient glows, and crisp 1px borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do NOT use transition: all. Use specific transition properties like transition-colors or transition-transform.
